system.description:
Drake of the Last Watch is a name everyone knows: his strength and his bond with the natural world are legend across Arneyan. You train to fight like him and to stand for what he stood for. Less a school, more a devotion.

  • Drake's Fury: while raging, you have Advantage in Trip and Grapple contests. In natural wilderness, Primeval Instincts covers every physical check, not only those that could cost you HP, Exhaustion or your life.
    • 9th level: a creature you Trip or Grapple while raging also takes your Rage damage bonus.
  • Legend's Path: Advantage on checks to identify, track or commune with natural creatures and places, and Drake's name opens doors wherever you go.
